name: SU8_noSb
comment: HYPOTHETICAL control material for the Sb K-edge study: SU-8 composition of Neustroeva 2021 with antimony removed (all other mass fractions kept and renormalised), same density. Not a real resist recipe: Sb belongs to the photo-acid generator (triarylsulfonium hexafluoroantimonate).

delta.source: kept identical to SU8 so that only the interaction physics differs (removing 1.3 % Sb changes the electron density by ~1 %)
